subject: Science
title: Class 10 Science Olympiad — Paper 3
instructions: The time allowed for this paper is 60 minutes.
This paper contains 50 objective-type (multiple-choice) questions carrying a total of 60 marks.
There is no negative marking for wrong answers.
Each question has four options; choose the one correct answer.
Section 1 and other regular sections carry 1 mark per question; the Achievers Section carries 3 marks per question.
Use of calculators is not permitted unless specified.

questions.question: Statement: All metals conduct electricity. Iron is a metal. Conclusion: Iron conducts electricity.
Complete the analogy: Plant is to Photosynthesis as Animal is to ____
A is the brother of B. B is the daughter of C. How is A related to C?
Find the missing number in the series: 4, 9, 16, 25, __
Find the odd one out: Oxygen, Nitrogen, Hydrogen, Water
If 8 machines produce 480 units in a day, how many units will 12 machines produce in a day at the same rate?
If '×' means '+', '+' means '-', '-' means '÷', and '÷' means '×', evaluate: 10 + 5 - 2
Find the next term: 3, 6, 11, 18, 27, __
If in a code LIGHT is written as MJHIU, how is SOUND written?
Five friends are sitting in a row. Raj is to the left of Simran but right of Aman. Simran is to the left of Priya. Who is in the middle?
Which type of chemical reaction occurs when calcium oxide reacts with water?
If the resistance of a conductor is doubled while keeping voltage constant, what happens to the current?
A person cannot see distant objects clearly but can see nearby objects. Which defect of vision is this?
In human beings, sex of the child is determined by the chromosome contributed by which parent?
Which part of the brain controls balance and posture?
Why does a plant kept in the dark for 3 days fail to test positive for starch when a leaf is tested with iodine?
options: No photosynthesis occurred due to absence of light

questions.question: If a person's pancreas fails to produce sufficient insulin, what condition results?
Why does a copper wire glow when placed in a solution of silver nitrate?
options: Copper is more reactive than silver and displaces it
Silver is more reactive than copper

questions.question: Which observation best supports that respiration is an exothermic process?
options: Plants absorb carbon dioxide during the day
Body temperature is maintained due to energy released during respiration
Chlorophyll gives leaves their green colour

questions.question: Which of these is a non-renewable source of energy?
A wire of resistivity rho is stretched to double its length with volume constant. How does its resistance change?
A cell has a shorter life span in humans and lacks a nucleus; which cell is being described?
If the earth did not have a magnetic field, what would be a likely consequence?
options: Harmful cosmic and solar radiation would reach Earth's surface more easily

questions.question: Which process in plants converts light energy into chemical energy?
What is the function of the ozone layer?
Which element has the electronic configuration 2, 8, 7?
What is the pH range of acidic solutions?
Which gas is evolved when a metal reacts with a dilute acid?
A metal reacts vigorously with cold water forming a hydroxide and hydrogen gas with fire. Which metal fits this description?
During electrolysis of water, which gas is collected in double the volume at one electrode?
Which of the following is a exothermic reaction?
Which law states that the current through a conductor is directly proportional to the potential difference across it?
Which metal is extracted from bauxite ore?
A concave mirror produces an image that is virtual, erect and magnified. Where must the object be placed?
options: Between the pole and the focus

questions.question: Which vitamin deficiency causes scurvy?
Which hormone regulates blood sugar level in humans?
A patient's blood does not clot properly due to lack of a certain mineral in diet. Which mineral is most likely deficient?
Which gas is responsible for the greenhouse effect predominantly?
Which part of the eye controls the amount of light entering it?
Why is a food chain usually limited to 4-5 trophic levels?
options: Consumers cannot digest energy beyond 4 levels
Energy decreases at each successive trophic level

questions.question: A ray of light passes from air into glass. What happens to its speed and how does it bend relative to the normal?
options: Speed increases and it bends away from the normal
Speed decreases and it bends towards the normal
Speed remains the same and it does not bend
Speed decreases and it bends away from the normal

questions.question: Why does the sky appear blue during the daytime?
options: Reflection of oceans onto the sky
Absorption of red light by the atmosphere
Scattering of shorter wavelengths of light by atmospheric particles

questions.question: Why do stomata usually close at night?
options: To reduce water loss when photosynthesis is not occurring
To increase the rate of photosynthesis
To allow more carbon dioxide entry for respiration only

questions.question: In a food web, what would likely happen to the population of grasshoppers if all frogs (their predators) were removed?
Which of the following is the most reactive metal among these?
A student mixes solutions of lead nitrate and potassium iodide and observes a yellow precipitate. Classify this reaction and justify.
options: Double displacement (precipitation) reaction because ions exchange partners forming an insoluble salt
Combination reaction because two substances combine
Decomposition reaction because a precipitate forms
Displacement reaction because lead displaces potassium

questions.question: A green plant is kept in a well-lit room but its soil is never watered for several days. Predict the immediate effect on photosynthesis and explain why.
options: No effect on photosynthesis since light is unaffected
Photosynthesis increases due to more light absorption
Photosynthesis decreases because stomata close to conserve water, reducing CO2 uptake
Photosynthesis stops immediately due to lack of chlorophyll

questions.question: Two identical resistors are first connected in series and then in parallel across the same battery. Compare the total power consumed in both cases.
options: Power cannot be compared without knowing resistance value
Power consumed is the same in both cases
Power consumed in parallel combination is 4 times that in series combination
Power consumed in series is greater

questions.question: In a pedigree study, a trait appears only in male offspring of a family across generations, skipping females entirely. What does this suggest about the trait's inheritance?
options: It is caused entirely by environmental factors
It is likely a dominant autosomal trait
It is likely an X-linked recessive trait
It is a Y-linked dominant trait inherited from mother

questions.question: During an experiment, a student adds dilute HCl to a mixture of zinc granules and copper turnings. Which metal reacts and why?
options: Zinc reacts because it is more reactive than hydrogen, while copper does not react as it is less reactive than hydrogen
Neither reacts as HCl is too dilute
Copper reacts because it is denser
